about: Hello! This is Ayush Verma. I am currently working as Scientist-'B'/Assistant Director at Software Technology Parks of India, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India and a Ph.D. Scholar at School of Computer and Systems Sciences, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and I am very fortunate to be advised by Prof. Manju Khari.
My research interests include Cyber Security, Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
